newsitem.title: UK: Sears agrees Littlewoods exclusivity deal.
newsitem.headline: Sears agrees Littlewoods exclusivity deal.

text.p: British retail group Sears Plc said on Wednesday it had signed an exclusivity agreement with Littlewoods for talks on the sale of Sears' home shopping business Freemans.
Sears said it would negotiate a renewed agreement under which Littlewoods would acquire Freemans on what it called "substantially" the same terms as those announced on January 13 this year.
In January, Littlewoods had agreed to buy Freemans for 395 million stg but the acquisition was referred to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission on competition grounds.

Littlewoods then withdrew when it emerged Sears was talking to other possible buyers. Sears had said it could not give exclusivity to Littlewoods after it had received other offers and wanted to consider the best in the interests of shareholders.
